items.title: Purportedly AI-Generated Memorial Posters Reportedly Presented Fabricated Child Portraits as Victims of South African School Transport Crash
items.summary: Purportedly AI-generated memorial posters reportedly presented fabricated child portraits as pupils killed in a school-transport crash near Vanderbijlpark, South Africa. items.searchText: oof-aii-830011 sixt's ai rental-car inspection reportedly led to a £1,659 bill for pre-existing damage in manchester, england a renter at manchester airport, england, reportedly received a £1,659 bill after sixt's car gate ai scanner missed existing scratches at pickup but flagged them at return. sixt pursued payment for eight weeks and threatened collections and legal action despite scans reportedly showing the damage predated the rental. the company canceled the damage entry and bill after an ombudsman intervened. location not specified sixt car gate, ai vehicle inspection systems, computer vision systems, ai enabled decision support systems, enterprise ai systems vfm® — value flow mechanisms architecture
